en.bdb: One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankaar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਿਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaeh paatisaahaa paatisaahu sira(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is true emperor and He is creator of the emperor of the emperors.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡਿ ਵਸੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sachai takhat nivaas hai saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd vasa(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: He sits on the throne of truth and resides in holy congregation, the abode of truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਣੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੂਲਿ ਫਿਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sach furamaan neesaan sach sachaa hukam na mool fira(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Truth is His mark and truth He utters and His command is irrefutable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਟਕਸਾਲ ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਹੁਇ ਸਬਦ ਮਿਲੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sach sabadh Takasaal sach gur te gur hui sabadh mila(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: He whose Word is true and whose treasure is true, is attainable in the form of the word of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਗ ਰਤਨ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਭਾਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: sachee bhagat bha(n)ddaar sach raag ratan keeratan bhaava(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: His devotion is true, His warehouse is true and He likes love and praise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਦੋਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sachaa pa(n)th hai sach dhohee sach raaj kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: The way of the gurmukhs is also true, their slogan is truth and their kingdom is also the kingdom of truth.
The treader on this path, crossing the world goes on to meet the Lord.
